```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`wrds_update_pq()` exports a WRDS PostgreSQL table to a local Parquet file and
skips the download when existing metadata indicate that the local file is
current.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
Sys.setenv(DATA_DIR = "~/pq_data")

wrds_update_pq("dsi", "crsp")
wrds_update_pq("dsf", "crsp", obs = 1000, keep = c("permno", "date", "ret"))
wrds_update_pq("company", "comp", rename = c(conm = "company_name"))
```

Use `wrds_schema_to_pq()` for schema-wide refreshes and `wrds_sql_to_pq()` for
custom WRDS SQL queries.
